quote: Frogeye leaf spot is a yield-reducing disease of soybean caused by the pathogen Cercospora sojina. Rcs3 has provided durable resistance to all known races of C. sojina since its discovery in the cultivar Davis during the 1980s.
notes: Same indirect-reference pattern as Lr34: the resistance-conferring sentence names the pathogen (C. sojina), not the disease itself; the disease name only appears in the preceding sentence. Included specifically to test whether Lr34's adjacent-sentence-quoting gap generalizes to a different paper/crop or was specific to that one paper's phrasing. resistance_type left 'unknown': 'durable' describes the resistance's longevity, not the ASR/APR/quantitative axis this schema captures.
